title: Bar Juice 5000 Cherry Berry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Cherry Berry from Bar Juice 5000 is a sweet, lively fruit blend that pairs juicy Cherry with a medley of ripe Berries. The Cherry leads with its classic red-fruit sweetness, while the supporting berries add extra depth, tang and brightness. An icy finish cools the blend on the exhale, bringing a clean, refreshing edge to the mix. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid offers rapid absorption and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping in pod kits and vape pens. With strengths in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg, it caters to a wide range of preferences. Made in the UK and blended at 50PG/50VG, Bar Juice 5000 Nic Salts are designed for crisp, concentrated flavour with minimal vapour — perfect for fans of chilled, fruity profiles in a refillable 10ml format. Ideal for refillable vape UK and vape starter kit UK devices .
